input.quote: 14.2.6 Termination for Change of Control of PB. PB will notify SFJ in writing promptly (and in any event within [***]) following the entering into of a definitive agreement with respect to a Change of Control of PB. SFJ may, in its sole discretion, terminate this Agreement in its entirety at any time following a Change of Control of PB that occurs prior to the date of payment by PB of the final Approval Payment.
input.rationale: The assignment clause itself (Section 15.6) is acceptable and at or near the preferred position: it is mutual and expressly permits either Party, without consent, to assign the entire Agreement to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, sale of stock or sale of all or substantially all assets (including by operation of law), subject only to a guarantee/continuing-liability mechanic. The absence of a "not unreasonably withheld" qualifier on consent for other assignments is a minor sub-element, noted only. The failure is in Article 14: Section 14.2.6 gives SFJ a sole-discretion right to terminate the entire Agreement following a Change of Control of PB and triggers a payment of 150% of Development Costs paid or incurred by SFJ. A counterparty termination (and effective re-pricing) right on our change of control is expressly walk-away territory under this rule, and it undercuts the M&A assignment freedom granted by Section 15.6. We therefore delete SFJ's change-of-control termination right and the associated 150% payment, retaining PB's notice obligation and the Section 15.6 assumption/guarantee protection; the consequential paragraph p0766, which operates only upon such a termination, is deleted as conforming. PB's own Change of Control Buy-Out Option in Section 6.7.2 is a right in our favour and is not flagged.

proposal.summary: Remove SFJ's change-of-control termination right and the associated 150% payment
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15.6 already permits assignment to an affiliate or successor with a parent guarantee, so we have deleted SFJ's sole-discretion right to terminate (and the 150% Development Costs payment) on a Change of Control of PB, which our playbook treats as a walk-away term. If SFJ needs comfort, we can discuss a successor creditworthiness/assumption condition instead.

ops.oldText: SFJ may, in its sole discretion, terminate this Agreement in its entirety at any time following a Change of Control of PB that occurs prior to the date of payment by PB of the final Approval Payment. In the event that SFJ terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 14.2.6, then, in exchange for purchasing the Trial Data Package including the Research Results included therein as set forth in Section 11.1.1.4, PB will pay to SFJ within [***] of the date of termination an amount equal to one hundred fifty percent (150%) of Development Costs which were paid or incurred by SFJ.
ops.newText: A Change of Control of PB shall not give SFJ any right to terminate this Agreement or to accelerate, increase or otherwise modify any payment obligation of PB hereunder, and this Agreement shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with its terms following any such Change of Control, provided that PB or its successor shall assume, and where applicable guarantee, PB's obligations hereunder in accordance with Section 15.6.
